invariants: RuntimeService/EventStore remain authoritative; imported runtimes never become a second control plane.
All model/tool side effects remain behind CAPT authority, ToolBroker, approvals, receipts and evidence semantics.
Freeze upstream repository SHA and license before copying code; preserve provenance and notices.
Do not vendor whole donor repositories merely for convenience; transplant only justified capability.
Do not weaken Secure Intake/Quarantine, approval, provenance, ClaimGuard, verification, filesystem, network or secret boundaries.
Do not push, merge, publish or release. Local branch/worktree integration only.
Preserve unrelated user work; target only this isolated clean worktree.
Every copied/reimplemented consequential mechanism receives discriminating regression tests.
Every donor must end with an explicit disposition and rationale; no silent omissions.
Completion requires contract drift checks, targeted tests, full CAPT suite, clean diff checks, and a final donor ledger.
